2.text: Garment. Heb. "cloak," (Sanct.) such as were worn by people under no disgrace. C. iv. 20. Thamar had one very costly. 2 K. xiii. 18. C. --- Justice, or mercy. God is bound to fulfill his gracious promises. W.

3.text: His. Gr. "thy." Christ, the sun of justice, would effect this. Is. lx. 1.

4.text: Piety. Thus shall Jerusalem be distinguished after the captivity; but still more so when Christ shall appear, and give peace to his Church, after the ages of persecution.

5.text: Arise. C. iv. 36. Is. lii. 2. --- God. They remember his law with pleasure.

6.text: Children. Gr. "the throne." The return of the captives was a triumph. Is. xlvi. 20. and xlix. 22. They had abundance of horses, &c. 1 Esd. ii. 66. Darius gave them a convoy of 1000 horsemen. 3 Esd. v. 2. Jos. Ant. xi. 4.

7.text: Diligently, without stumbling under the pillar of God's protection. Is. xl. 3. C.

8.text: Woods. This is a poetical description. They shall pass through the sands of Arabia, as if they were under a delightful shade.
